name: Video meetings
description: Rooms of the built-in video meeting server: see who is in a room, mute or remove someone, lock or end the room.

capabilities.name: Read a room
capabilities.description: List who is in one of the plugin's declared meeting rooms. Maps to kernel command sfu::room.

capabilities.name: Mute someone
capabilities.description: Stop forwarding one person's audio or video in a room. Maps to kernel command sfu::mute.

capabilities.name: Remove someone
capabilities.description: Put one person out of a room at once. Maps to kernel command sfu::remove.

capabilities.name: End a room
capabilities.description: End a meeting room for everyone in it. Maps to kernel command sfu::end.

capabilities.name: Lock a room
capabilities.description: While a room is locked nobody new can join it. Maps to kernel command sfu::lock.
